tokens.name: zr-navy
tokens.usage: Zr3i ink. Text colour and the dark theme surface. Not used for large blocks or the sidebar; green carries those.

tokens.name: zr-field
tokens.usage: Zr3i deep field green, the main brand colour. Sidebar, content blocks, table headers, login and report blocks, primary button fill. Text on it is white, mist, amber or sage (4.8:1 or more).

tokens.name: zr-forest
tokens.usage: Zr3i deep forest, an older darker green kept for compatibility. New work uses zr-field.

tokens.name: zr-sage
tokens.usage: Zr3i sage, the identity field. Large brand panels and the primary action in the dark theme; text on it is zr-navy, never white.

tokens.name: zr-mist
tokens.usage: Zr3i mist. Soft panels, selected rows, report page tint; text on it is ink or zr-forest.

tokens.name: zr-amber
tokens.usage: Zr3i amber, the label accent on dark fields. Never body text on light grounds; use accent-ink there.

tokens.name: zr-ember
tokens.usage: Zr3i orange rule. Hairline rules and large marks only (3.5:1 on white); never text, never a verdict colour.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, forms and report pages. Text on it is ink, ink-muted or a status colour.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Table headers, inset wells, image frames, code and hash blocks.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on ground, surface and sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and axis labels on ground, surface and sunken. 6.0:1 or better.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and table row dividers. Carries no meaning; do not use for control borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, buttons, checkboxes and chart axes. 3:1 or better on surface and ground.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary fill, active nav marker and the wordmark. Text on a brand fill uses on-brand.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of a brand fill.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill. 12:1 light, 8:1 dark.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links and text buttons on ground and surface.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with a 2px offset. On a zr-sage panel use zr-navy instead.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Amber used as text: eyebrow labels and the synthetic-data notice on ground and surface.

tokens.name: synthetic-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the SYNTHETIC DATA banner and watermark ground. Text on it is accent-ink.

tokens.name: confirmed
tokens.usage: CONFIRMED verdict: text and icon (filled circle) on surface and confirmed-bg.

tokens.name: confirmed-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind a CONFIRMED pill or row tint.

tokens.name: flagged
tokens.usage: FLAGGED verdict: text and icon (triangle). A fact that needs a person to look, not a rejection.

tokens.name: flagged-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind a FLAGGED pill or row tint.

tokens.name: pending
tokens.usage: pending_second_pass and no_usable_pass: text and icon (half circle). Blue so it never reads as green or red.

tokens.name: pending-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind a pending pill or row tint.

tokens.name: not-assessable
tokens.usage: NOT_ASSESSABLE and below-resolution: text and icon (dashed circle). Grey means the test could not run; it is not a 'no crop' result.

tokens.name: not-assessable-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind a NOT_ASSESSABLE pill or row tint.

tokens.name: img-true
tokens.usage: Placeholder tone for true-colour chips only. Replace with the real scene.

tokens.name: img-ndvi-low
tokens.usage: NDVI ramp low end (bare soil, below 0.25). Always paired with the legend.

tokens.name: img-ndvi-mid
tokens.usage: NDVI ramp middle (0.25 to 0.6).

tokens.name: img-ndvi-high
tokens.usage: NDVI ramp high end (above 0.6).

tokens.name: img-boundary
tokens.usage: Declared boundary outline drawn over imagery. 2px, with a navy halo so it reads on light and dark scenes.

tokens.name: img-measured
tokens.usage: Measured (pixel-test) footprint outline over imagery. Always differs from the declared outline in shape: dashed.

tokens.name: band-a
tokens.usage: Risk band A (lowest risk) fill. Always a square chip with the letter A and the word; letter set 24px bold in on-band-a.

tokens.name: on-band-a
tokens.usage: Letter on band A. 4.05:1, allowed at 24px bold.

tokens.name: band-b
tokens.usage: Risk band B fill, chip with the letter B and the word.

tokens.name: on-band-b
tokens.usage: Letter on band B (6.6:1).

tokens.name: band-c
tokens.usage: Risk band C fill, chip with the letter C and the word.

tokens.name: on-band-c
tokens.usage: Letter on band C (8:1).

tokens.name: band-d
tokens.usage: Risk band D fill, chip with the letter D and the word.

tokens.name: on-band-d
tokens.usage: Letter on band D (4.8:1).

tokens.name: band-e
tokens.usage: Risk band E (highest risk) fill, chip with the letter E and the word.

tokens.name: on-band-e
tokens.usage: Letter on band E (6.3:1).

tokens.name: maturity-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the maturity badge (specified, calibrated, validated) on risk screens.

tokens.name: maturity-ink
tokens.usage: Maturity badge text and border on maturity-bg. 7:1 light, 8:1 dark.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Report cover title and login hero. One per page.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Screen titles and report section openers.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Measured area is 7.3 feddan against 10.0 declared.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Area noise at this size is about 4.6%.
styles.usage: Table cells, helper text and report footnotes.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows and field labels, upper case in English only. Arabic uses ar-label.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Parcel ids, areas, dates and counts in tables. Always left-to-right.

styles.name: ar-display
styles.usage: Arabic counterpart of display-xl and display-lg, in Cairo Bold.

styles.name: ar-body
styles.usage: Arabic body. One size step above Latin, taller leading.

styles.name: ar-small
styles.sample: هامش القياس عند هذا الحجم نحو ٤٫٦٪.

styles.name: ar-label
styles.usage: Arabic eyebrows and field labels. No upper-casing, no letter-spacing.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, pill padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Control inner gap, table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Field gap, compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default card padding and page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card gap and section gap inside a screen.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between report sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Login hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Soft small corners: status pills, tags, risk band chips, maturity badge, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, banners, menus, image frames.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, content blocks, tables, login card, modals.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Filter chips and the language toggle.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Status circles and map dots. Full circles only.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and the date-slider tooltip. Cards use a hairline, not a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Only on the login card over a photographic field.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of any interactive target.

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Operator and customer sidebar.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width of a desktop screen.

tokens.name: page-a4-w
tokens.usage: Report page width at 96 dpi (A4).

tokens.name: phone-w
tokens.usage: Reference width for the agronomist and farmer screens.
